subject: Re: Custom Coupe Ultimate
author: Xandu
body:
I like the Custom Coupe Ultimate in Burnout 2: Point of Impact. I tried it in Burnout 3: Takedown a couple of days a go and I was totally rubbish 🙂... I didnt like the way it handled and it's really slow. Top speed is only 190mph.

So I quickly went back to my US Circuit Racer... not my favourite car either but it will have to do for now.
